'''Jan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was recruited into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after joining the Rebel Alliance, he was sent on a mission to meet with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. After meeting with the rebel hero, he participated, without knowing, in a [[Mission to steal a DSS-02 shield generator|mission]] to steal a [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]] for the [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden rebel base]].
